title: session/watch
description: Request `session/watch` (client -> daemon): declare whether this connection receives a session's live event stream. The connection that started a session receives its `session/event` stream without declaring anything; any other connection must ask for it, and stops receiving it when it asks to stop or when it closes. Watching delivers what is emitted from that moment on — the history is read with `session/log`, and the daemon never queues events for a connection that is gone.

watch.description: true to receive the session's events on this connection, false to stop.

watching.description: Whether this connection is now watching that session.
